notes: and how is read as one rendering of the single waw under rule 55's pair sentence; the competing reading would leave how added under that rule's count.
temol shilshom is fused rather than split, since heretofore writes neither lexeme in particular.

The It of It hath fully been showed me stays with the impersonally recast Hophal as a genuinely pleonastic dummy (rule 17's presentative-dummy sentence, rule 44); rule 25's expletive ruling governs a verbless clause with a supplied copula, which this is not — contrast the added It of v. 22.
The et of unto thy mother in law is MACULA-tagged R, so it is the preposition H854 and takes the word written for it (rule 16's closing caution).
